probe: Windows LoadLibraryExW with DONT_RESOLVE_DLL_REFERENCES (0x1), executed in a 32-bit Windows PowerShell process
scope: Confirms only that the x86 Windows loader can map the PE image without resolving imports or invoking DLL initialization. This is not a normal plugin load, dependency check, startup test, or gameplay validation.
note: An initial probe from a 64-bit Python process returned Win32 error 193 because the candidate is PE32; the same no-resolve mapping probe succeeded from a 32-bit process.
